reviewSamples.author: Photo of denise meroni
reviewSamples.text: We hired Limb Logic to remove 2 really high coconut Palms that unfortunately did not make it through last winter’s freeze. Carson did a quick job and removed the stumps too at an amazing price. Plus gave us a lot of knowledge on what to replant. I am going to use him for all our trimmings in the future.
